2609.10494.title: IBIB: A Protocol for Measuring Enterprise AI Systems by Serving Route, Not Model Identifier
2609.10494.paper_summary: Enterprises deploy systems, not checkpoints. Usable capability depends jointly on weights, serving route, precision, output contract, and harness, yet all 18 audited benchmarks score advertised model identifiers. We treat this as measurement error and give a protocol that makes it reportable. It has three parts. A gold-blind capability-binding preflight verifies that a route can execute the evaluation contract before any task reaches it; a reliability-inclusive first-pass scoring rule keeps failure in the score while keeping unsupported capability out; and adjudication is structurally score-blind. We call the protocol IB2 and release its algorithms, classification tables, request contract, and manifest schemas. Its reference instantiation, 128 locked tasks and 987 assertions over document, spreadsheet, chart, tool and database work, stays sealed: the procedure is the artifact, not the corpus. Across eleven systems, four results. Capability availability is measurable: two complete single-route runs on identical weights later failed distinct predicates of the finalized binding gate, while a third passed that gate before a fresh run. The advertised identifier exposed neither limit. Discrimination is not uniform: four of seven suites saturate under a six-system band, with the spread almost entirely from governed database work and multi-tab joins, so we report interval-backed resolution groups, not ranks; two of the nominal five-label output's four cuts fail multiplicity adjustment. Serving-arm choice moved one declared revision and precision from 77.38 to 82.54, paired interval [0.11,10.60], though the arms differ in access mode, harness generation, and the serving tool-call parser, and harness generation is a property of our evaluator, not any endpoint. Excluding failed responses from denominators changes the point ordering, so reliability inclusion changes a conclusion, not its wording.
2609.10494.paper_summary_zh: 企業部署系統，而非檢查點。可用能力共同依賴於權重、服務路徑、精度、輸出合約和繫帶，但所有18個經審核的基準都得分於廣告模型識別符。我們將此視為測量誤差，並提供一個可報告的協議。它有三個部分。一個金盲能力綁定的預檢驗證路徑能在任何任務到達之前執行評估合約；一個包含可靠性的首次評分規則在保持失敗計入分數的同時排除不支持的能力；而裁決在結構上是盲分數的。我們稱這個協議為IB2，並發布其算法、分類表、請求合約和清單架構。其參考實例，128個鎖定任務和987個關於文件、電子表格、圖表、工具和數據庫工作的斷言，保持封閉：程序是文物，而非語料。跨越十一個系統，四個結果。能力可用性是可測量的：兩次在相同權重下的完整單路徑運行後，失敗於最終綁定閘的不同謂詞，而第三次在新運行之前通過了該閘。廣告識別符未暴露任何限制。區分度並不均勻：七個套件中的四個在六個系統帶下飽和，擴散幾乎完全來自受控數據庫工作和多標籤聯接，因此我們報告基於區間的解析組，而非排名；名義上五標籤輸出的四個切割中有兩個未能調整多重性。服務臂的選擇將一個聲明的修訂和精度從77.38移動到82.54，配對區間[0.11,10.60]，儘管這些臂在訪問模式、繫帶生成和服務工具調用解析器上有所不同，而繫帶生成是我們評估者的屬性，而非任何端點。從分母中排除失敗的響應會改變點的排序，因此可靠性包含會改變結論，而非其措辭。
